description: Prove that a change does what it should. Open the page headless, run steps (click, press, hold, drag, wheel, wait, frames, eval, until) and read `watch` expressions in the live scene after every frame and step, with `scene`, `camera`, `renderer`, `info` (renderer.info), `$('name')` and `$$('Type')` in scope (window globals such as `app` work too). `expect` claims are judged at the end, at any moment or at every frame, each pass or fail with its value, time, frame and step. Watched values come back only where they changed. Also page and console errors with explanations, and a screenshot. When it passes, keep it with three_scenario op save.

expect.description: Claims about the scene: "$('player').position.y > 1 @ end", "any: $('door').rotation.y > 1", "always: info.render.calls < 200", "x @ step 2", or {js, at}.

fixed_dt.description: deterministic clock: ms per frame (default 16.67); waits become frames

root.description: folder to serve when the page needs files above its own folder

seed.description: deterministic clock: seed for Math.random; the clock is paused and moves one fixed frame at a time, so every run gives the same frames and pixels

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

wait.description: ms to let the scene run before the first step (default 1000)

watch.description: JS expressions to follow, e.g. $('player').position, info.render.calls

name: three_play
title: Run steps and watch the scene
